question: In a certain code language, FAX is written as EGZBWY. How will SKIN be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

The alphabet positional value of given letter in a word is added +1 and subtracted -1.

FAX is written as EGZBWY.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8e9ee6cc9566f709d43c06b29099dd0f7d1e53b9b3aeaaca75cad67c371f59.png] 

Similarly,

SKIN will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2717eec382742f509cb80d184a9f4555f1ccfae487fd3d282d502dcf50726d28.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"RTJLHJMO".**
